<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko" translate="no" class="notranslate">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="google" content="notranslate">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1">
<title>우루포차 테스트</title>
<meta property="og:title" content="우루포차 테스트">
<meta property="og:description" content="12개 질문으로 찾는 나와 꼭 닮은 우루포차, 친구와 궁합까지!">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/static/pretendard-dynamic-subset.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  @font-face { font-family: 'DearFromsol'; src: url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Project-Noonnu/2607161334@griun-fromsol-rg/griun-fromsol-rg/Griun_Fromsol-Rg.woff2') format('woff2'); font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; size-adjust: 118%; }
  /* 폰트(알트): 큰 글씨·버튼 춤추는사람들 (Hada Type · OFL) · 일반 글씨 그리운 프롬솔 */
  @font-face { font-family: 'AltBold'; src: url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Project-Noonnu/2610082345@dancingpeoples-dance-vf/dancingpeoples-dance-vf/DancingPeoples-Dance-VF.woff2') format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
  @font-face { font-family: 'AltReg'; src: url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Project-Noonnu/2610082345@dancingpeoples-dance-vf/dancingpeoples-dance-vf/DancingPeoples-Dance-VF.woff2') format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
  /* ===== 솜사탕 컬러 (우루포차 키 컬러로 맞춰 바꾸면 전체가 바뀜) ===== */
  :root {
    --pink: #f5a9cd; --pink-deep: #ee86ba; --mint: #b5d978; --sky: #78d2f5; --lemon: #fff0a0; --lilac: #d9b8f2;
    --ink: #33264a; --sub: #66587d; --pink-text: #d63c86; --violet: #8a4fc4; --blue-text: #1b77b5; --line: #f1e8f7; --card: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
    --good: #1d8f5c; --bad: #d63c86;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  html, body { margin: 0; }
  body {
    font-family: 'DearFromsol', 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink); min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100dvh; padding: 20px 16px 40px;
    display: flex; justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffbfe4 0%, #ffd9ef 28%, #fff3f8 52%, #fbf8d6 74%, #e2f7cc 100%) fixed;
  }
  button, input, textarea { font-family: inherit; }
  b, strong { font-family: 'AltReg', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; }
  /* 강조 글씨는 써라운드 에어(얇은 버전). 큰 제목·질문만 써라운드 */
  .chip, .qno, .qtop span, .match b, .match .lbl, .pick b, .score, .charname, .coupon b,
  .treebox .badge, .invite, #toast, .tags span, .pal-say b, .modal h3, .squish-hint b, .secret, .pal-say .t, .match .lbl { font-family: 'AltReg', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400 !important; }
  /* 떠다니는 솜사탕 구름 */
  #fluff { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 0; }
  .puff { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(16px); background: #fff; opacity: .75; animation: float 14s ease-in-out infinite; }
  /* 키비주얼의 비눗방울 */
  .orb { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .85; animation: float 10s ease-in-out infinite;
         box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.8), inset -6px -8px 14px rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
  .orb::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 16%; width: 22%; height: 22%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.9); }
  .spark { position: absolute; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.9); animation: twinkle 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .dots { position: absolute; width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .45;
          background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #fff27a 2.2px, transparent 2.6px); background-size: 9px 9px;
          -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, #000 20%, transparent 70%); mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, #000 20%, transparent 70%); }
  .kv { display: block; width: calc(100% + 20px); margin: -14px -10px 14px; border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(238,134,186,.25); }
  .urulogo { display: block; width: 190px; margin: -4px auto 4px; }
  .credit { text-align: center; font-size: 10px; color: #b49cc0; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 4px; }
  .wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .screen { display: none; }
  .screen.on { display: block; animation: pop .45s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.3); }
  .card { background: var(--card); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-radius: 36px; padding: 26px 20px;
          margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: center; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
          box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(236, 127, 176, .18), 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .9) inset; }
  .cute { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
  .logo { display: block; max-width: 230px; max-height: 120px; margin: 0 auto 12px; }
  .wordmark { font-size: 64px; line-height: .9; margin: 4px 0 10px; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 1px;
              text-shadow: 0 0 0 transparent, 2px 2px 0 var(--pink-deep), -2px 2px 0 var(--pink-deep), 2px -2px 0 var(--pink-deep), -2px -2px 0 var(--pink-deep), 0 6px 14px rgba(236, 127, 176, .35); }
  .chip { display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); background: var(--lemon); padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }
  h1 { font-size: 31px; margin: 16px 0 10px; color: var(--ink); }
  .lead { color: var(--sub); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 16px; }
  /* 버튼: 말랑한 젤리 버튼 (아래 두께감 + 윤기 + 누르면 쏙 들어감) */
  .btn { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 999px;
         padding: 15px 18px; margin-top: 14px; font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif !important; font-weight: 400 !important; font-size: 17.5px; letter-spacing: -.2px;
         color: #fff; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(160,30,90,.3);
         background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffa3cf 0%, #f26aa9 55%, #e0559a 100%);
         box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #c4407f, 0 10px 18px rgba(224,85,154,.35), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55);
         transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; }
  .btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; top: 3px; height: 34%; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.4), rgba(255,255,255,0)); pointer-events: none; }
  .btn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c4407f, 0 4px 10px rgba(224,85,154,.3), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55); }
  .btn.shine::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 40%; left: -60%; transform: skewX(-20deg);
                      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0), rgba(255,255,255,.6), rgba(255,255,255,0)); animation: shine 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes shine { 0%, 55% { left: -60%; } 100% { left: 130%; } }
  .btn .av { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #fff; flex: none; margin-left: -6px; }
  .btn .go { flex: none; font-size: 13px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; text-shadow: none; }
  .btn.big { font-size: 19px; padding: 14px 18px; }
  .btn.mint { color: #3b5a12; text-shadow: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e4f5bf 0%, #bfe27f 55%, #a6d062 100%);
              box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #84b043, 0 10px 18px rgba(130,180,60,.3), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
  .btn.mint:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #84b043, 0 4px 10px rgba(130,180,60,.25); }
  .btn.sky { color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,90,140,.35); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a9e3fb 0%, #6cc8f0 55%, #48b2e6 100%);
             box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #2f93c7, 0 10px 18px rgba(60,160,220,.3), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55); }
  .btn.sky:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #2f93c7, 0 4px 10px rgba(60,160,220,.25); }
  .btn.soft { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); text-shadow: none; border: 2px solid #eadff5; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #eadff5; font-size: 16px; padding: 13px; }
  .btn.soft::before { display: none; }
  .btn.soft:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 #eadff5; }
  .btn.line { background: #fff; color: #2f93c7; text-shadow: none; border: 2px solid #a9e3fb; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #a9e3fb; font-size: 16px; padding: 13px; }
  .btn.line::before { display: none; }
  .btn.line:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 #a9e3fb; }
  input[type=text] { width: 100%; font-size: 17px; padding: 15px; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; text-align: center; outline: none; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; }
  input[type=text]:focus { border-color: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(247, 168, 203, .25); }
  .invite { margin: 0 0 14px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 22px; background: #fff0f7; color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; }
  .peek { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin: 4px 0 18px; }
  .peek img { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid #fff; margin-left: -10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(205, 184, 242, .5); }
  .peek img:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
  .msg { color: var(--pink-text); font-size: 13px; min-height: 18px; margin-top: 8px; }

  /* 질문 */
  .qtop { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ink); }
  .qtop button { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--sub); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; }
  .bar { height: 18px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #f4b6d4; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 16px; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(224,90,155,.18); }
  .bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; border-radius: 999px; transition: width .35s;
           background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px), linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8fc4, #e0559a);
           background-size: 22px 22px, 100% 100%; animation: candy 1s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes candy { to { background-position: 22px 0, 0 0; } }
  .qcard { padding: 30px 20px; }
  .qno { display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; background: #a978e0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; }
  .qtext { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400 !important; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.3px; margin: 14px 0 22px; word-break: keep-all; }
  .opt { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: center; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 28px; padding: 18px 16px; margin-top: 12px;
         font-size: 17px; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; word-break: keep-all;
         box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(205, 184, 242, .3), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7); transition: transform .15s; }
  .opt.a { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3f9, #ffd9ea); }
  .opt.b { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f1f9ff, #d6ecfb); }
  .opt { font-family: 'DearFromsol', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; }
  .opt:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  .opt.a.chosen { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9cca, #ee6aa8); color: #fff; border-color: #fff; transform: scale(.97);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffc7e1, 0 8px 18px rgba(238,106,168,.4); }
  .opt.b.chosen { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8fdcfb, #4bb6e8); color: #fff; border-color: #fff; transform: scale(.97);
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #bfe9fb, 0 8px 18px rgba(75,182,232,.4); }
  .opt.chosen::after { content: ' ✔'; }

  #quiz.on { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: calc(100vh - 60px); min-height: calc(100dvh - 60px); }
  .qmid { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 8vh; }
  .barwrap { position: relative; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .barwrap .bar { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .rider { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 34px; height: 34px; margin: -17px 0 0 -17px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
           border: 3px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(224,90,155,.45); transition: left .35s; }
  /* 질문마다 빼꼼 나오는 우루포차 + TMI 말풍선 */
  .pal { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin: 0 6px -18px; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .pal img { width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(238,134,186,.3);
             cursor: pointer; animation: peekin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.4); flex: none; }
  .pal-say { background: #fff; border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 4px; padding: 9px 13px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink);
             box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(205,184,242,.35); margin-bottom: 26px; text-align: left; word-break: keep-all; animation: pop .4s .1s both; }
  .pal-say b { color: var(--pink-text); }
  .pal-say .t { display: block; font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: var(--violet); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .qcard { padding-top: 34px; }
  .fx { position: fixed; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; font-size: 18px; animation: fly .9s ease-out forwards; }
  .squish { animation: squish .55s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1); }
  .heroWrap { position: relative; width: 220px; margin: 8px auto 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: margin .4s; }
  .heroWrap.glow { margin: 22px auto 24px; }
  .heroWrap .hero { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .boing { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #fff; color: var(--pink-text); border-radius: 999px;
           padding: 4px 11px; font-family: 'DearFromsol', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(238,134,186,.35); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .boing.on { animation: boing .8s ease-out; }
  .squish-hint { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin: 20px 0 12px; }
  .squish-hint b { color: var(--pink-text); }
  .points { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin: 2px 0 6px; }
  .points div { flex: 1; background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 6px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; word-break: keep-all; }
  .points div, .modal h3 { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif !important; }
  .points span { display: block; font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
  /* 공유 창 (복사가 막힌 환경에서도 직접 복사할 수 있게) */
  .modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: rgba(90,70,119,.35); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
  .modal.on { display: flex; }
  .modal .box { background: #fff; border-radius: 30px; padding: 22px 18px; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; animation: pop .35s; }
  .modal h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 20px; }
  .modal p { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--sub); }
  .modal textarea { width: 100%; height: 110px; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink); resize: none; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* 이스터에그: 숨어 있는 아기 굴 + 시크릿 쿠폰 */
  .sec { position: relative; }
  .hider { position: absolute; right: 18px; bottom: -14px; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid #fff;
           box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(205,184,242,.5); cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-14deg); animation: wiggle 4s ease-in-out infinite; z-index: 3; }
  .secret { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--violet); font-weight: 800; }
  .eggcode { margin: 4px 0 6px; padding: 14px; border: 3px dashed #ee6aa8; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff5fa;
             font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; color: var(--pink-text); letter-spacing: 1px; word-break: break-all; }
  .eggimg { width: 92px; height: 92px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 4px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffd9ea; margin: -60px auto 8px; display: block; }
  @keyframes wiggle { 0%, 82%, 100% { transform: rotate(-14deg); } 86% { transform: rotate(8deg) translateY(-4px); } 90% { transform: rotate(-20deg); } 94% { transform: rotate(4deg) translateY(-2px); } }

  /* 구매 유도 */
  .price { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--pink-text); margin: 2px 0 0; }
  .buyhero { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; background: #fff; border-radius: 26px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .buyhero img { width: 86px; height: 86px; border-radius: 22px; object-fit: cover; flex: none; }
  .buyhero b { display: block; font-size: 16px; }
  .buyhero span { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--sub); line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 2px; }
  .ribbon { display: inline-block; font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #fff; background: #e0559a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .duoBuy { margin-top: 10px; display: block; font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--good); background: #eaf8f0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
  .giftBtn { display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #fff; background: #e0559a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 12px; text-decoration: none; }
  .stickybuy { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 12px; transform: translate(-50%, 140%); width: calc(100% - 32px); max-width: 400px; z-index: 30;
               display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 7px 7px 8px;
               box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(90,70,119,.25); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2); }
  .stickybuy.on { transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
  .stickybuy img { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; flex: none; }
  .stickybuy div { flex: 1; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); line-height: 1.3; }
  .stickybuy div b { display: block; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--ink); }
  .stickybuy a { flex: none; font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
                 background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f98fc2, #e05a9b); }
  /* 결과 혜택 (매장 · 온라인 하나로) */
  .benefit { margin-top: 14px; border: 2px dashed #ee6aa8; border-radius: 26px; padding: 16px 14px; background: #fff7fb; }
  .bhead { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink); }
  .boffer { font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--pink-text); margin-top: 6px; word-break: keep-all; line-height: 1.45; }
  .bnote { font-size: 13px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 3px; }
  .brow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .bbtn { position: relative; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px 8px 12px; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
          font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; }
  .bbtn span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 50px; height: 50px; margin: 0 auto 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff;
               font-size: 26px; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
  .bbtn small { display: block; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 3px; }
  .bbtn i { display: block; width: fit-content; margin: 8px auto 0; font-style: normal; font-size: 12.5px; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; }
  #passBtn { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffeef7, #ffd3e8); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #f2a6cb, 0 8px 16px rgba(238,106,168,.2); }
  #passBtn i { background: #e0559a; }
  #onlineBtn { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f2fbe6, #d6f0b8); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #a9d47a, 0 8px 16px rgba(130,180,60,.18); }
  #onlineBtn i { background: #6fa832; }
  .bbtn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08) !important; }
  .pass { padding-top: 18px; }
  .pass .urulogo { width: 150px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .passclock { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 0; margin: 6px 0 10px;
               background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8fc4, #a978e0, #6cc8f0, #a6d062, #ff8fc4); background-size: 300% 100%; animation: passflow 3s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes passflow { to { background-position: 300% 0; } }
  .passimg { width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 5px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ffd9ea; animation: hop 1.6s infinite; }
  .passname { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; margin-top: 10px; }
  .passtype { font-size: 14px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 2px; }
  .passoffer { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--pink-text); background: #fff0f7; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; margin-top: 12px; word-break: keep-all; }
  .passnote { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 8px; }
  .stores { display: grid; gap: 8px; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 4px; max-height: 50vh; overflow: auto; }
  .stores a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); background: #f7f2fd; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 15px; }
  .stores a.near { background: #ffe3f1; }
  .stores a em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); white-space: nowrap; }
  .stores a b { font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; }
  /* 쓰담쓰담 스페셜 리액션 */
  .petlv { display: inline-block; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--violet); margin-left: 6px; }
  .hero.twirl { animation: twirl .9s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1); }
  .hero.jump { animation: jump .8s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1); }
  .heroWrap.glow .hero { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ffd9ea, 0 0 0 9px #fff3a8, 0 0 0 13px #d6f2b8, 0 0 0 17px #cdeefe, 0 10px 30px rgba(236,127,176,.4); transition: box-shadow .5s; }
  .crown { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -30px; z-index: 2; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-8deg); font-size: 34px; display: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15)); }
  .heroWrap.king .crown { display: block; animation: peekin .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.5); }
  .bigpop { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 38%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); z-index: 55; pointer-events: none; text-align: center; background: #fff;
            border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 16px; width: max-content; max-width: 80vw; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(90,70,119,.3); animation: bigpop 1.9s ease-out forwards; }
  .bigpop b { white-space: nowrap; }
  .bigpop b { display: block; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; color: var(--pink-text); }
  .bigpop span { display: block; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 2px; }
  @keyframes bigpop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -40%) scale(.6); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.06); } 25% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } 80% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -62%); } }
  @keyframes twirl { from { transform: rotate(0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotate(200deg) scale(.85); } to { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); } }
  @keyframes jump { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 30% { transform: translateY(-40px) scale(.95, 1.05); } 55% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.1, .9); } 75% { transform: translateY(-12px); } }

  /* 분석 중 */
  .loading { padding: 70px 20px; }
  .loading .cute { font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .loading p { color: var(--sub); font-size: 14px; }
  .bounce { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .bounce img { width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(238,134,186,.3); animation: hop 1s infinite; }
  .bounce img:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .15s; } .bounce img:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; } .bounce img:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .45s; }


  /* 결과 */
  .codebox { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
  .codebox div { width: 58px; padding: 9px 0 7px; border-radius: 20px; border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(205,184,242,.35); }
  .codebox div:nth-child(1) { background: #ffdcee; } .codebox div:nth-child(2) { background: #ebf6d6; }
  .codebox div:nth-child(3) { background: #dff4fd; } .codebox div:nth-child(4) { background: #fff6c9; }
  .codebox b { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .codebox small { display: block; font-size: 15px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .codewords { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sub); margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .hero { width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; display: block; margin: 0 auto 14px; border: 6px solid #fff;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #ffd9ea, 0 12px 30px rgba(236,127,176,.3); }
  .typename { font-size: 30px; margin: 4px 0 0; word-break: keep-all; }
  .charname { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--pink-text); margin: 6px 0 12px; }
  .tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
  .tags span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--line); }
  .sec h2 { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0 0 12px; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
  .traits { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; text-align: left; }
  .traits li { padding: 12px 14px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.55; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; word-break: keep-all; }
  .traits li:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .matches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .match { border-radius: 26px; padding: 14px 10px; background: #fff; }
  .match .lbl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
  .match.good .lbl { color: var(--good); } .match.bad .lbl { color: var(--bad); }
  .match img { width: 78px; height: 78px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; display: block; margin: 8px auto; border: 3px solid var(--line); }
  .match b { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
  .match em { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: var(--sub); margin: 2px 0 6px; word-break: keep-all; }
  .match p { margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; word-break: keep-all; }
  .coupon { margin-top: 14px; border: 2px dashed var(--pink); border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px; background: #fff7fb; text-align: left; }
  .coupon b { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
  .coupon span { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* 우루포차 나무 */
  .treebox { position: relative; border-radius: 28px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #fff 0%, #fff6fb 60%, #f6efff 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  .treebox svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
  .treebox .badge { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; background: var(--lilac); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 12px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 10px; }
  .legend i { display: inline-block; width: 18px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 4px; }
  .pick { margin-top: 12px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; text-align: left; display: none; }
  .pick.on { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
  .pick img { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid var(--line); flex: none; }
  .pick b { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
  .pick em { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; color: var(--sub); margin: 2px 0 4px; }
  .pick p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; word-break: keep-all; }
  .score { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; margin-left: 4px; }
  .duo { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin: 6px 0 10px; }
  .duo img { width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 4px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(205,184,242,.4); }
  .duo span { font-size: 26px; }
  .duotitle { font-size: 24px; margin: 6px 0 6px; }
  .note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.5; }
  #toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 28px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 40; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
           padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(90,70,119,.25);
           opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .2s; white-space: nowrap; }
  #toast.on { opacity: 1; }

  @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(14px, -20px) scale(1.08); } }
  @keyframes twinkle { 0%, 100% { opacity: .3; transform: scale(.7); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); } }
  @keyframes peekin { from { transform: translateY(24px) scale(.6); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes fly { from { transform: translate(0,0) scale(.6); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translate(var(--dx), -70px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; } }
  @keyframes squish { 0% { transform: scale(1,1); } 30% { transform: scale(1.12,.84); } 55% { transform: scale(.92,1.1); } 80% { transform: scale(1.04,.97); } 100% { transform: scale(1,1); } }
  @keyframes boing { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 10px) scale(.6); } 25% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -18px) scale(1.1); } 75% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -34px); } }
  @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.96) translateY(8px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes hop { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1, 1); } 40% { transform: translateY(-14px) scale(.9, 1.1); } 80% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.15, .85); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .puff, .orb, .spark, .screen.on, .bounce img { animation: none; } }

  /* 줄바꿈: 단어 중간에서 끊기지 않게 + 줄 길이를 고르게 */
  body { word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
  h1, h2, h3, .qtext, .typename, .charname, .lead, .boffer, .bnote, .duotitle, .secret, .squish-hint, .pal-say, .passoffer, .passnote, .match p, .match em, .opt, .bigpop span, .modal p { text-wrap: balance; }
  .traits li { text-wrap: balance; position: relative; padding-left: 34px !important; }
  .traits li::before { content: '✦'; position: absolute; left: 14px; color: #e9579c; }
  #duoDesc, .pick p { text-wrap: pretty; }
  /* 혜택 카드 (결과 바로 아래) */
  .benefitcard { padding-top: 20px; position: relative; }
  .bribbon { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .minirow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
  .mini { border: 1.5px solid #f1e8f7; background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; padding: 11px 6px; font-family: 'AltReg', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
  .mini:active { background: #fff6fb; }
  .imgbox { padding: 16px; max-height: 92vh; overflow: auto; }
  .imgbox img { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(90,70,119,.18); }
  .imghint { font-size: 13px; color: var(--sub); margin: 10px 0 0 !important; }
  .imgbox .btn { margin-top: 10px; }
  /* 결과 카드: 포차 이름 + 성격 바로 아래 */
  .herocard .urulogo { width: 120px !important; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .herocard .hero { width: 190px; height: 190px; }
  .herocard .heroWrap { width: 190px; }
  .pre { font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 2px; }
  .herocard .typename { font-size: 34px; margin: 2px 0 4px; }
  .herocard .charname { font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  .herocard .traits { text-align: left; background: #faf6fd; border-radius: 18px; padding: 6px 4px; margin: 0 0 12px; }
  .herocard .traits li { background: none; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px 8px 30px !important; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; border-bottom: 1.5px dashed #efe6f7; border-radius: 0; }
  .herocard .traits li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .herocard .traits li::before { left: 12px; }
  .herocard { position: relative; }
  /* 결과 공개 (스토리형 3장) */
  .reveal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 70; display: none; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffbfe4 0%, #ffe3f1 40%, #fdf8dc 75%, #e2f7cc 100%); }
  .reveal.on { display: block; }
  .rvbars { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 16px; right: 16px; display: flex; gap: 6px; z-index: 2; }
  .rvbars i { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.6); overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
  .rvbars i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: var(--p, 0%); background: #e9579c; border-radius: 4px; }
  .rvskip { position: absolute; top: 28px; right: 14px; z-index: 3; border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: var(--sub); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px;
            font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
  .rvslide { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 60px 24px 70px;
             opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: scale(.96); transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s; }
  .rvslide.on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: none; }
  .rvsmall { font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 6px; }
  .rvbig { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 40px; margin: 0; animation: hop 1.2s infinite; }
  .rvdots { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
  .rvdots img { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid #fff; filter: blur(3px) saturate(.7); animation: hop 1s infinite; }
  .rvdots img:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .15s; } .rvdots img:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; }
  .rvlogo { width: 140px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .rvhero { width: min(64vw, 260px); height: min(64vw, 260px); border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 7px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #ffd9ea, 0 18px 40px rgba(236,127,176,.35); margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .rvslide.on .rvhero { animation: pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.5); }
  .rvname { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 46px; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -1px; }
  .rvsub { font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; color: var(--pink-text); margin: 8px 0 0; }
  .rvrare { font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--violet); margin: 14px 0 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .rvrare:empty { display: none; }
  .rvpair { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 16px 0 18px; }
  .rvpair img { width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 5px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(236,127,176,.3); }
  .rvpair span { font-size: 34px; }
  .rvslide .btn { width: auto; padding: 15px 30px; margin-top: 26px; }
  .rvtap { position: absolute; bottom: 22px; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0; }
  /* 희귀도 · 천생연분 세트 · 보조 링크 */
  .rare { display: inline-block; font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--violet); background: #f4effc; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 12px; margin: -4px 0 12px; }
  .rare:empty { display: none; }
  .setcard { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px 14px 10px 10px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); text-align: left;
             background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #f1e8f7; border-radius: 18px; }
  .setimgs { display: flex; flex: none; }
  .setimgs img { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
  .setimgs img + img { margin-left: -12px; }
  .settx { flex: 1; } .settx b { display: block; font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; }
  .settx small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--sub); }
  .setcard .ch { color: #d4bfe6; font-size: 24px; }
  .links { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .links button { border: 0; background: none; font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--sub); cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; }
  .links i { width: 1px; height: 12px; background: #e6daf2; }
  /* 결과 슬라이더 */
  .slider { position: relative; margin: 0 -20px; }
  .track { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; cursor: grab; }
  .track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .track.drag { cursor: grabbing; scroll-snap-type: none; }
  .slide { flex: 0 0 100%; scroll-snap-align: center; padding: 4px 20px 0; min-height: 330px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; user-select: none; }
  .slide img { -webkit-user-drag: none; }
  .slabel { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  .slabel.good { color: var(--good); } .slabel.bad { color: var(--bad); }
  .pair { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .pair img { width: 108px; height: 108px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 5px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffe1ef, 0 10px 22px rgba(236,127,176,.22); }
  .pair span { font-size: 28px; }
  .sname { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 26px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
  .sline { font-size: 15.5px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-wrap: balance; }
  .sdots { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 12px 0 16px; }
  .shint { font-family: 'DearFromsol', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--sub); margin-right: 6px; }
  .sdots button { width: 8px; height: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #e9dff3; cursor: pointer; transition: width .25s, background .25s; }
  .sdots button.on { width: 22px; background: #e9579c; }
  .sarrow { position: absolute; top: 42%; z-index: 3; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.9); color: var(--sub);
            font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(205,184,242,.4); display: none; }
  .sarrow.l { left: 6px; } .sarrow.r { right: 6px; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .sarrow { display: block; } }
  .treecard { text-align: left; position: relative; }
  .treecard h2 { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 19px; margin: 0 0 12px; text-align: center; }
  .treecard .lead { text-align: center; font-size: 14px; margin: -4px 0 14px; }
  /* 결과 4장 일체형 */
  #result.on { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: calc(100vh - 60px); height: calc(100dvh - 60px); }
  .rtabs { flex: none; display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; margin: 0 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
           backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(214,120,170,.16); }
  .rtabs button { position: relative; flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; padding: 10px 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
                  font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--sub); transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
  .rtabs button.on { background: #e9579c; color: #fff; }
  .rtabs button i { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffc928; }
  .rtabs button.on i { display: none; }
  .pager { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; margin: 0 -16px; }
  .pager::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .pager.drag { scroll-snap-type: none; cursor: grabbing; user-select: none; }
  .page { flex: 0 0 100%; scroll-snap-align: start; scroll-snap-stop: always; overflow-y: auto; padding: 2px 16px 90px; scrollbar-width: none; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
  .page::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .page .card { margin-bottom: 12px; position: relative; }
  .nextbtn { display: block; margin: 4px auto 0; border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.75); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer;
             font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--pink-text); }
  .herocard .hero { width: 148px; height: 148px; }
  .herocard .heroWrap { width: 148px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .herocard .urulogo { width: 96px !important; }
  .herocard .squish-hint { margin: 10px 0 6px; font-size: 12px; }
  .herocard .typename { font-size: 30px; margin: 0 0 2px; }
  .herocard .charname { margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .herocard .rare { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 13px; }
  .herocard .traits li { padding: 6px 12px 6px 30px !important; font-size: 14.5px; }
  .herocard .tags span { padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  .herocard .buyrow { margin-top: 12px; }
  .herocard { padding-top: 16px; }
  .matchcard { text-align: center; }
  .slabel { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; margin: 0 0 12px; }
  .slabel.good { color: var(--good); } .slabel.bad { color: var(--bad); }
  .pair { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .pair img { width: 100px; height: 100px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 5px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffe1ef, 0 8px 18px rgba(236,127,176,.2); }
  .pair.sm img { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-width: 3px; }
  .pair span { font-size: 26px; }
  .sname { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin: 0 0 6px; } .sname.sm { font-size: 19px; }
  .sline { font-size: 15px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 290px; text-wrap: balance; }
  .matchcard .setcard { margin-top: 14px; }
  /* 버튼 슬림하게 */
  .btn { padding: 12px 16px !important; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(233,87,156,.2); margin-top: 12px; }
  .btn.big { font-size: 16.5px; padding: 13px 16px !important; }
  .btn.soft, .btn.ghost, .btn.line { padding: 11px !important; font-size: 15px; }
  .rtabs { padding: 3px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .rtabs button { padding: 7px 0; font-size: 13.5px; }
  .rtabs button i { top: 4px; }
  .stickybuy { padding: 5px 5px 5px 6px; bottom: 10px; border-radius: 18px; }
  .stickybuy img { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
  .stickybuy div b { font-size: 14px; }
  .stickybuy a { padding: 9px 14px !important; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px !important; }
  /* 언어 선택 + 일본어·중국어 폰트 */
  .langs { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .langs button { border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: var(--sub); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 11px; cursor: pointer;
                  font-family: 'Pretendard', -apple-system, sans-serif !important; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .langs button.on { background: #fff; color: var(--pink-text); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(214,120,170,.18); }
  #langsHome { justify-content: flex-end; }
  html[lang=ja] body, html[lang=ja] body *:not(.langs button) { font-family: 'Zen Maru Gothic', 'Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', sans-serif !important; }
  html[lang=zh] body, html[lang=zh] body *:not(.langs button) { font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif !important; }
  html[lang=ja] :is(h1, h2, h3, .cute, .typename, .qtext, .btn, .rtabs button, .sname, .slabel, .bribbon, .row b, .settx b, .chip, .qno, .boffer, .passname, .passoffer, b),
  html[lang=zh] :is(h1, h2, h3, .cute, .typename, .qtext, .btn, .rtabs button, .sname, .slabel, .bribbon, .row b, .settx b, .chip, .qno, .boffer, .passname, .passoffer, b) { font-weight: 700 !important; }
  html[lang=ja] .opt, html[lang=zh] .opt { font-size: 15px; }
  html[lang=en] .rtabs button, html[lang=ja] .rtabs button { font-size: 13px; }
  /* ===== v14 정리: 결과 탭 + 세련된 톤 (위 스타일을 덮어씀) ===== */
  .card { border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.93); border: 1px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(214,120,170,.13); }
  .btn { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; overflow: visible;
         font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif !important; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.2px; color: #fff; text-shadow: none;
         background: #e9579c; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(233,87,156,.26); transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s; }
  .btn::before, .btn::after { display: none !important; }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(.98); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(233,87,156,.22); }
  .btn.mint { background: #8cc152; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(140,193,82,.25); }
  .btn.sky { background: #4fb4e6; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(79,180,230,.25); }
  .btn.soft { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border: 1.5px solid #eee3f6; box-shadow: none; font-size: 15.5px; padding: 14px; }
  .btn.ghost { background: #f1f8e9; color: #3f7a1d; box-shadow: none; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px; }
  .textbtn { display: block; margin: 18px auto 8px; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--sub); font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; }
  .herocard .urulogo { width: 150px; }
  .herocard .codebox { margin-top: 8px; }
  .codebox div { width: 52px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: none; border: 1.5px solid #fff; }
  .hero { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ffe1ef, 0 10px 26px rgba(236,127,176,.25); }
  .squish-hint { font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; margin: 16px 0 10px; }
  .tags span { border: 1.5px solid #f1e8f7; padding: 6px 11px; }
  .buyrow { margin-top: 18px; }
  .buyrow .btn { margin-top: 0; }
  .price { margin-top: 8px; }
  .invbanner { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; background: #fff0f7; color: var(--pink-text);
               font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; cursor: pointer; }
  .tabs { position: sticky; top: 10px; z-index: 20; display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; margin: 0 0 12px; border-radius: 999px;
          background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(214,120,170,.16); }
  .tabs button { position: relative; flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; padding: 11px 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
                 font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--sub); transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
  .tabs button.on { background: #e9579c; color: #fff; }
  .tabs button i { position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 12px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffc928; }
  .tabs button.on i { display: none; }
  .panel { display: none; position: relative; text-align: left; }
  .panel.on { display: block; animation: pop .3s; }
  .panel h2 { font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 19px; margin: 0 0 12px; text-align: center; }
  .panel .lead { text-align: center; font-size: 14px; margin: -4px 0 14px; }
  .traits li { background: #faf6fd; border-radius: 14px; }
  .match { background: #faf6fd; border-radius: 20px; text-align: center; }
  hr.split { border: 0; border-top: 1.5px dashed #f1e8f7; margin: 20px 0; }
  #inviterCard { text-align: center; }
  .boffer { font-family: 'AltBold', sans-serif; font-size: 16.5px; color: var(--pink-text); background: #fff0f7; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center; margin: 0; }
  .bnote { text-align: center; margin-top: 6px; }
  .rows { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink);
         background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #f1e8f7; border-radius: 18px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: background .15s, transform .12s; }
  .row:active { transform: scale(.985); background: #fff6fb; }
  .row .ic { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: none; border-radius: 13px; background: #fff0f7; font-size: 21px; }
  #onlineBtn .ic { background: #f1f8e9; } #storeBtn .ic { background: #eaf6fd; } #moreBtn .ic { background: #f4effc; }
  .row .tx { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .row b { display: block; font-family: 'AltBold', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15.5px; }
  .row small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--sub); margin-top: 2px; }
  .row .ch { color: #d4bfe6; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; }
  .secret { text-align: center; font-family: 'AltReg', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; margin: 16px 0 0; }
  .hider { z-index: 5; }
  #passBtn.row, #onlineBtn.row { background: #fff; box-shadow: none; }
  #passBtn.row:active, #onlineBtn.row:active { background: #fff6fb; box-shadow: none !important; }
  .stickybuy { border-radius: 22px; }
  .stickybuy a { border-radius: 14px; background: #e9579c; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="fluff"></div>
<div class="wrap">

  <!-- ① 시작 -->
  <section id="home" class="screen on">
    <div class="langs" id="langsHome"></div>
    <div class="card">
      <img class="kv" id="kv" alt="Disney URUPOCHA CHAN">
      <h1 class="cute">우루포차 테스트</h1>
      <p class="lead">12개 질문으로 찾는 나랑 꼭 닮은 우루포차!<br>결과를 공유하면 친구와의 궁합도 볼 수 있어요.</p>
      <div class="invite" id="invite" style="display:none"></div>
      <div class="peek" id="peek"></div>
      <input type="text" id="nick" maxlength="8" placeholder="닉네임 (최대 8자)" autocomplete="off">
      <button class="btn big shine" id="startBtn">테스트 시작하기</button>
      <div class="msg" id="homeMsg"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ② 질문 -->
  <section id="quiz" class="screen">
    <div class="qtop"><button id="backBtn">← 이전</button><span id="qcount">1 / 12</span></div>
    <div class="barwrap"><div class="bar"><i id="barFill"></i></div><img class="rider" id="rider" alt=""></div>
    <div class="qmid">
    <div class="pal" id="pal"><img id="palImg" alt=""><div class="pal-say" id="palSay"></div></div>
    <div class="card qcard">
      <div class="qno" id="qno">Q1</div>
      <div class="qtext" id="qtext"></div>
      <button class="opt a" id="optA"></button>
      <button class="opt b" id="optB"></button>
    </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ③ 분석 중 -->
  <section id="loading" class="screen">
    <div class="card loading">
      <div class="bounce" id="bounce"></div>
      <div class="cute">보들보들 분석 중</div>
      <p>나와 꼭 닮은 우루포차를 찾고 있어요</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ④ 결과: 4장을 좌우로 넘기는 일체형 -->
  <section id="result" class="screen">
    <nav class="rtabs" id="rtabs">
      <button class="on">내 결과</button><button>궁합</button><button>혜택<i></i></button><button>친구 나무</button>
    </nav>
    <div class="pager" id="pager">
      <div class="page">
        <div class="card herocard" id="heroCard">
          <img class="urulogo" id="uruLogo" alt="Disney URUPOCHA CHAN">
          <div class="heroWrap" id="heroWrap"><span class="crown">👑</span><img class="hero" id="heroImg" alt=""><span class="boing" id="boing"></span></div>
          <div class="squish-hint" id="squishHint">인형을 눌러서 <b>쓰담쓰담</b> 해보세요</div>
          <div class="pre" id="preName"></div>
          <p class="typename cute" id="typeName"></p>
          <div class="charname" id="charName"></div>
          <div class="rare" id="rareLine"></div>
          <ul class="traits" id="traits"></ul>
          <div class="tags" id="tags"></div>
          <div id="buyCard" class="buyrow">
            <a class="btn" id="takeBtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener"></a>
            <div class="price" id="buyPrice"></div>
            <div class="links"><button id="saveResult">📷 결과 이미지 저장</button><i></i><button id="invite2">💌 친구 초대</button></div>
          </div>
          <button class="invbanner" id="invBanner" style="display:none"></button>
        </div>
        <button class="nextbtn" data-go="1">궁합 보러 가기 ›</button>
      </div>

      <div class="page">
        <div class="card matchcard" id="p-match">
          <div id="inviterCard" style="display:none">
            <p class="slabel good" id="inviterTitle"></p>
            <div class="pair"><img id="duoMe" alt=""><span>💌</span><img id="duoThem" alt=""></div>
            <p class="sname" id="duoLabel"></p>
            <p class="sline" id="duoDesc"></p>
            <hr class="split">
          </div>
          <p class="slabel good">💞 나의 천생연분</p>
          <div class="pair"><img id="pairMe" alt=""><span>💞</span><img id="pairBest" alt=""></div>
          <p class="sname" id="bestName"></p>
          <p class="sline" id="bestLine"></p>
          <a class="setcard" id="setCard" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            <span class="setimgs"><img id="setA" alt=""><img id="setB" alt=""></span>
            <span class="settx"><b id="setTitle"></b><small>천생연분 세트로 같이 데려가기</small></span><span class="ch">›</span>
          </a>
          <hr class="split">
          <p class="slabel bad">💥 은근 삐걱</p>
          <div class="pair sm"><img id="pairMe2" alt=""><span>💥</span><img id="pairWorst" alt=""></div>
          <p class="sname sm" id="worstName"></p>
          <p class="sline" id="worstLine"></p>
        </div>
        <button class="nextbtn" data-go="2">결과 혜택 받으러 가기 ›</button>
      </div>

      <div class="page">
    <div class="card benefitcard" id="p-gift">
      <div class="bribbon">🎁 결과 받은 사람 혜택</div>
      <div class="boffer" id="bOffer"></div>
      <div class="bnote" id="bNote"></div>
      <div class="rows">
        <button class="row" id="passBtn"><span class="ic">🏬</span><span class="tx"><b>매장에서 받기</b><small>직원에게 혜택 화면 보여주기</small></span><span class="ch">›</span></button>
        <button class="row" id="onlineBtn"><span class="ic">📱</span><span class="tx"><b>온라인에서 받기</b><small>더현대Hi 결제 때 코드 입력</small></span><span class="ch">›</span></button>
        <button class="row" id="storeBtn"><span class="ic">📍</span><span class="tx"><b>가까운 디즈니스토어</b><small>네이버 지도로 길찾기</small></span><span class="ch">›</span></button>
        <a class="row" id="moreBtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="ic">🛍️</span><span class="tx"><b id="moreTitle"></b><small>더현대Hi에서 구경하기</small></span><span class="ch">›</span></a>
      </div>
    </div>
        <button class="nextbtn" data-go="3">친구 나무 보러 가기 ›</button>
      </div>

      <div class="page">
    <div class="card treecard" id="p-tree">
      <h2>🌳 나의 우루포차 나무</h2>
      <p class="lead">내 링크로 테스트한 친구들이 나무에 열려요.<br>친구를 누르면 나와의 궁합이 보여요.</p>
      <div class="treebox"><span class="badge" id="treeBadge"></span><svg id="tree" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="나의 우루포차 나무"></svg></div>
      <div class="legend">
        <span><i style="background:#ec7fb0"></i>천생연분</span><span><i style="background:#f7a8cb"></i>찰떡 케미</span>
        <span><i style="background:#9fd3f4"></i>보송 케미</span><span><i style="background:#cdb8f2"></i>반전 케미</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pick" id="pick"></div>
      <button class="btn" id="inviteBtn">💌 친구 초대하고 궁합 보기</button>
      <div class="minirow"><button class="mini" id="saveTree">🌳 나무 이미지 저장</button><button class="mini" id="refreshBtn">↻ 나무 새로고침</button></div>
      <div class="note" id="treeNote"></div>
    </div>
        <button class="textbtn" id="retryBtn">테스트 다시 하기</button>
        <div class="langs"></div>
        <div class="credit">©Disney ©Disney. Based on the "Winnie the Pooh" works by A.A. Milne and E.H. Shepard.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <img class="hider" id="hider" alt="숨어 있는 친구">
  </section>

</div>
<div id="toast"></div>

<div class="stickybuy" id="stickyBuy"><img id="stickyImg" alt=""><div><b id="stickyName"></b><span id="stickySub">매장 · 온라인 결과 혜택 있어요</span></div><a id="stickyBtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener">데려가기</a></div>
<div class="modal" id="eggModal">
  <div class="box" style="margin-top:40px">
    <img class="eggimg" id="eggImg" alt="">
    <h3 id="eggTitle"></h3>
    <p id="eggDesc"></p>
    <button class="btn soft" id="eggClose">닫기</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="modal" id="passModal">
  <div class="box pass">
    <img class="urulogo" id="passLogo" alt="Disney URUPOCHA CHAN">
    <div class="passclock" id="passClock"></div>
    <img class="passimg" id="passImg" alt="">
    <div class="passname" id="passName"></div>
    <div class="passtype" id="passType"></div>
    <div class="passoffer" id="passOffer"></div>
    <div class="passnote">직원에게 이 화면을 보여주세요<br>시계가 움직이는 화면만 유효해요</div>
    <button class="btn soft" id="passClose">닫기</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="modal" id="storeModal">
  <div class="box">
    <h3>📍 디즈니스토어 찾기</h3>
    <p id="storeMsg">가까운 순서로 보여드려요. 누르면 네이버 지도로 길찾기가 열려요.</p>
    <div class="stores" id="storeList"></div>
    <button class="btn soft" id="storeClose">닫기</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="modal" id="imgModal">
  <div class="box imgbox">
    <img id="imgOut" alt="저장할 이미지">
    <p class="imghint">이미지를 길게 눌러서 저장할 수도 있어요</p>
    <button class="btn" id="imgShare">공유하기</button>
    <a class="btn soft" id="imgSave" download="urupocha.png">이미지 저장하기</a>
    <button class="textbtn" id="imgClose">닫기</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="modal" id="shareModal">
  <div class="box">
    <h3>💌 친구 초대 링크</h3>
    <p>아래 내용을 복사해서 친구에게 보내주세요!</p>
    <textarea id="shareText" readonly></textarea>
    <button class="btn" id="copyBtn">복사하기</button>
    <button class="btn soft" id="closeShare">닫기</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  /* ===== 설정 ===================================================== */
  // Apps Script 웹 앱 주소(/exec). 비워 두면 '미리보기 모드': 예시 친구들로 나무를 보여주고 저장은 안 함
  var API_URL = '';

  var SEARCH_URL = 'https://hi.thehyundai.com/search?target=brand&targetCode=137447&brand=%EB%94%94%EC%A6%88%EB%8B%88%EC%8A%A4%ED%86%A0%EC%96%B4&tab=product&disPlaySize=36&q=';
  // ★ 혜택은 딱 하나: 매장에서는 결과 화면 보여주기 / 온라인(더현대Hi)에서는 같은 코드 입력
  var BENEFIT = {

  function km(a, b, c, d) { var R = 6371, r = Math.PI / 180, x = Math.sin((c - a) * r / 2), y = Math.sin((d - b) * r / 2); return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(x * x + Math.cos(a * r) * Math.cos(c * r) * y * y)); }
  var MOBILE = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  function openNaver(s) {
    track('store', s.name);
    var web = 'https://map.naver.com/p/search/' + encodeURIComponent(s.q);
    if (LANG !== 'ko') { window.open('https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=' + s.lat + ',' + s.lng + '&travelmode=transit', '_blank'); return; }   // 외국어: 구글 지도
    if (!MOBILE) { window.open(web, '_blank'); return; }
    var app = 'nmap://route/public?dlat=' + s.lat + '&dlng=' + s.lng + '&dname=' + encodeURIComponent('디즈니스토어 ' + s.name) + '&appname=' + encodeURIComponent(location.hostname || 'urupocha');
    var t = setTimeout(function () { if (!document.hidden) location.href = web; }, 1500);   // 네이버 지도 앱이 없으면 웹으로
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function f() { if (document.hidden) { clearTimeout(t); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', f); } });
    location.href = app;
  }
  function storeList(pos) {
    var list = STORES.map(function (s) { return { s: s, d: pos ? km(pos.lat, pos.lng, s.lat, s.lng) : null }; });
    if (pos) list.sort(function (a, b) { return a.d - b.d; });
    var box = $('storeList'); box.innerHTML = '';
    list.forEach(function (it, i) {
      var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; if (pos && i === 0) a.className = 'near';
      var b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = (pos && i === 0 ? '⭐ ' : '') + it.s.name;
      var em = document.createElement('em'); em.textContent = it.d == null ? L('find_route') : (it.d < 1 ? Math.round(it.d * 1000) + 'm' : it.d.toFixed(1) + 'km') + ' →';
      a.appendChild(b); a.appendChild(em); a.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { ev.preventDefault(); openNaver(it.s); });
      box.appendChild(a);
    });
    $('storeMsg').textContent = pos ? L('nearest', { name: list[0].s.name, d: $('storeList').firstChild.lastChild.textContent.replace(' →', '') }) : L('no_loc');
    $('storeModal').classList.add('on');
  }
  $('storeBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) { storeList(null); return; }
    toast(L('locating'));
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (p) { storeList({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); },
      function () { storeList(null); }, { timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 300000 });
  });
  $('storeClose').addEventListener('click', function () { $('storeModal').classList.remove('on'); });

  $('closeShare').addEventListener('click', function () { $('shareModal').classList.remove('on'); });
  $('backBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { if (step > 0) { step--; renderQuestion(); } });
  $('retryBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { window.scrollTo(0, 0); $('stickyBuy').classList.remove('on'); show('home'); });
  $('inviteBtn').addEventListener('click', invite);
  $('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', loadTree);
  $('takeBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { track('product', current.ch.name); });
  $('moreBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { track('more', current.ch.name); });

  $('bOffer').textContent = bt('offer'); $('bNote').textContent = bt('note');
  if (!BENEFIT.code) $('onlineBtn').style.display = 'none';

  /* ===== 이미지: 로고·키비주얼은 공식 에셋 그대로. 캐릭터 사진 7종은 키비주얼에서, 나머지 9종은 상품 목록 캡처에서 잘라냄 ===== */
  var IMAGES = {"mickey": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "lumiere": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "daisy": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "minnie": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tigger": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "oyster": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "donald": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cheshire": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "moana": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "piglet": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "rabbit": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "chip": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "angel": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "eeyore": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "stitch": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pooh": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
  var LOGO_SRC = 'data:image/png;base64,';
  var KV_SRC = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  $('kv').src = KV_SRC; $('uruLogo').src = LOGO_SRC;
  ['oyster', 'cheshire', 'tigger', 'eeyore', 'lumiere', 'moana'].forEach(function (k) { var i = document.createElement('img'); i.src = IMAGES[k]; i.alt = CHARS[k].name; i.dataset.k = k; $('peek').appendChild(i); });
  load();
  if (me && me.nickname) $('nick').value = me.nickname;
  if (FROM && (!me || me.id !== FROM)) { $('invite').style.display = 'block'; $('invite').textContent = L('invited', { nick: FROM_NAME || L('friend') }); }
  $('hider').src = IMAGES.oyster;
  initLang();
  makeFluff();
</script>
</body>
</html>
